provider: Tripo Studio (logged-in browser), DCC Bridge 'Unreal' v1.0.4 -> project plugin Tripo3DUEBridge
pipelineNotes: Bridge imports land in /Game/TripoModels/<ExportName>; Tools/RunTripoBatch03Integration.py moves them to /Game/Tripo/{Monsters,Town,Landmarks}, rebuilds PBR instances (Bridge omits BaseColor), sets Nanite and collision, and core-redirects the Bridge's transient animation skeleton (tripo_convert_<id>_Skeleton) that it renames without leaving a redirector.

Tools/OpenTripoBridge.py stops saving after one hour; material instances imported after that were lost and rebuilt. Use Tools/OpenTripoBridgeBatch03.py (no time limit, stop file) for future transfers.

Raw Tripo meshes are normalised to ~98 cm on the longest axis with the pivot at the bottom centre; BuildScale3D is left at 1 because UE 5.8 kept the unscaled bounds for Nanite meshes built with a scale.
Committed .uasset files are LFS 'lockable' and therefore read-only in the working copy; re-running integration on them needs a checkout/lock first.
